title: wizard-tests-and-fixtures
rawUserRequest: 循环执行 docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-25-interactive-installation-calibration-wizard.md 的全部工单流程；本 Work Item 补齐向导测试、集成 fixtures 和快照证据。

declaredIntent.summary: Expand deterministic wizard scenario coverage with representative mobile, monorepo, upgrade, recovery, and snapshot fixtures.

outOfScope: Changing production wizard or CalibrationSession behavior
Changing installer transaction, branch, rollback, or Work Item lifecycle semantics
Adding external SDKs or requiring unavailable mobile toolchains

sources.reason: Defines required iOS, Android, monorepo, upgrade, recovery, and snapshot scenarios.
Defines fixture evidence and verification terminology.
Existing wizard behavior contract extended by fixture scenarios.
Existing installation wizard scenario patterns and dry-run evidence.

riskAssessment.reason: Fixtures must represent requested stacks and lifecycle states without overstating unavailable external toolchain execution.

executionDecision.reason: The user authorized serial execution; deterministic local fixtures can cover the requested evidence without requiring external mobile SDKs.

preReviewWarnings: Review that fixture claims distinguish static shape evidence from unavailable external toolchain execution and that snapshots remain deterministic.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: Representative fixtures cover iOS Package/Project/Xcode-container/CocoaPods, Android application/multi-module/flavor/variant/JDK/test signals, generic mixed monorepo, dirty worktree, and Upgrade.
Scenario tests assert installation dry run/New Adoption/Upgrade, calibration resume/stale state, and activation failure as named test cases without invoking external mobile toolchains.
Snapshots cover three languages and representative facts, plan, checklist, and result output with stable ordering.
Focused fixture/snapshot tests and the complete project suite run with Python version and unavailable external checks recorded in the Summary.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: iOS Swift Package dry-run and Xcode Workspace New Adoption fixtures
Android application, multi-module, flavor/variant/JDK/unit/instrumented test fixtures
Mobile monorepo, generic mixed monorepo, dirty worktree, and existing-runtime Upgrade
Calibration resume/stale session and activation failure fixture flows
Deterministic snapshots for three languages and facts/plan/checklist/result

guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.

intent.problem: The wizard behavior has focused unit coverage but lacks a stable fixture matrix and snapshots proving representative iOS, Android, generic, monorepo, upgrade, recovery, and result scenarios.
constraints: Keep fixtures local, small, deterministic, and free of secrets or machine-specific paths.
Do not claim Xcode, Gradle, CocoaPods, JDK, or instrumented execution when the external toolchain is unavailable; test static signals and record limitations.
Do not change production wizard/session behavior in this Work Item.
intent.rationale: A fixture matrix makes the requested scenario coverage reviewable and repeatable while isolating external toolchain availability from repository-owned evidence.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: Set only when a human explicitly approves restricted governance paths.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
